# Footnotes

A named footnote[^note], a numeric one[^1] and an inline one^[Inline footnotes are *numbered* too.].
The named footnote again[^note] and a missing one[^missing].

- A list item with a reference[^2].

| Key | Value |
| --- | ----- |
| ref | cell[^1] |

> [!note] Callout
> A reference inside a callout[^2].

Last paragraph of the note.

[^1]: The numeric footnote, with a [[Welcome|link]] and **bold** text.
[^note]: The named footnote.
    Its second line is indented.

[^2]: Referenced from a list and from a callout.
[^unused]: Never referenced, so Reading view drops it.
